description_expanded: Sunlight, sea breezes, and the relaxed rhythm of Scenic Highway 30A surround this charming coastal cottage in Santa Rosa Beach. This beautifully refreshed four-bedroom, three-and-a-half-bath home accommodates up to 10 guests and sits just one block from the Gulf, offering a wonderfully convenient location for beach days and exploring the vibrant nearby community of Gulf Place. With its classic coastal architecture, welcoming porches, and thoughtfully updated interiors, this home blends timeless 30A character with modern comfort for an inviting retreat near the shore. Inside The Sandtrap , a reverse floor plan places the main living spaces on the second floor, allowing natural light to fill the home’s open gathering areas. The living room features comfortable seating and large windows that brighten the space, creating a relaxed setting for conversation, movie nights, or simply unwinding after a day in the sun. Just steps away, the kitchen features granite countertops, stainless steel appliances, and crisp white cabinetry, offering both style and functionality for preparing family meals or beach snacks. A dining area nearby invites guests to linger over dinner, while outdoor balconies provide additional spots to sip morning coffee or enjoy the coastal breeze. Recent updates, including new flooring, fixtures, and fresh paint throughout, give the entire home a polished, welcoming feel. The home’s layout offers both privacy and convenience for families and groups traveling together. The first-floor Primary Bedroom includes a king bed and a spacious ensuite bathroom with both a walk-in shower and a tub/shower combination. Upstairs, a queen bedroom with a private bathroom provides another comfortable retreat, while the third floor features an additional queen bedroom and a bunk room with a full-over-full bunk, making it a fun and practical setup for kids or additional guests. Beyond the home itself, this Santa Rosa Beach location captures the essence of the 30A lifestyle. The sugar-white sands and emerald waters of the Gulf are about a 7-8 minute walk away, making spontaneous beach outings within easy reach. Directly across Scenic Highway 30A, Goatfeathers Restaurant & Seafood Market is a beloved local stop for fresh Gulf seafood, casual dining, and take-home specialties. Just down the road toward Gulf Place, favorites like Papa Surf Burger and Shunk Gulley Oyster Bar offer laid-back coastal dining, live music, and sweeping Gulf views that capture the easygoing spirit of the area. A short stroll or bike ride brings you to Gulf Place , a lively community hub filled with boutique shops, local art galleries, cafés, and seasonal events. Whether you’re starting your day with a sunrise walk along the shoreline, grabbing a casual lunch after the beach, or enjoying sunset cocktails nearby, everything you need for a classic 30A getaway is within easy reach. From its inviting interiors to its walkable location near the beach, dining, and shopping, this charming Santa Rosa Beach cottage offers a relaxed and memorable home base for experiencing the best of Scenic Highway 30A. First Floor: King Primary Bedroom with Walk-In Shower and Tub/Shower Combo. Second Floor: Living Room with Patio Access, Kitchen, Dining, Queen Bedroom Walk-In Shower and Tub/Shower Combo, Powder Room. Third Floor: Queen Bedroom with Tub/Shower Combo, Bunk Room with Full Bunk.
